new.script:
set -u
mkdir -p '/home/user/.rayito/agent/deepagents/sessions'
exec 9>'/home/user/.rayito/agent/run.lock'
if ! flock -n 9; then printf '%s\n' '{"v":1,"type":"rayito.busy"}'; exit 0; fi
if [ ! -x '/opt/agents/deepagents/bin/python' ] || [ ! -r '/opt/agents/rayito/deepagents_runner.py' ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"v":1,"type":"rayito.runtime_missing"}'; exit 0; fi
exec '/opt/agents/deepagents/bin/python' '/opt/agents/rayito/deepagents_runner.py' '/home/user/.rayito/agent/deepagents/config.json'

resume.script:
set -u
mkdir -p '/home/user/.rayito/agent/deepagents/sessions'
exec 9>'/home/user/.rayito/agent/run.lock'
if ! flock -n 9; then printf '%s\n' '{"v":1,"type":"rayito.busy"}'; exit 0; fi
if [ ! -x '/opt/agents/deepagents/bin/python' ] || [ ! -r '/opt/agents/rayito/deepagents_runner.py' ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"v":1,"type":"rayito.runtime_missing"}'; exit 0; fi
exec '/opt/agents/deepagents/bin/python' '/opt/agents/rayito/deepagents_runner.py' '/home/user/.rayito/agent/deepagents/config.json'
